metadata.name: hodl_loans
metadata.description: HODL fixed-term cNGN loans on Solana

accounts.name: market
docs: Both required when the position still holds promo: closing it hands the promo back.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays rent for a new lender account (e.g. the gas-relay sponsor).

accounts.name: authority
docs: Must be the program's upgrade authority; becomes the admin.

accounts.name: config
docs: Carries `promo_cap_bps`, which bounds how much of a position's promo counts (spec §12).

accounts.name: promo_vault
docs: `create_promo_vault` is a separate admin action (`vault.rs`), so a market can run with
no promo vault at all. Required only when the position holds promo (`promo_balance >
0`) — the handler reverts with `PromoAccountsRequired` rather than silently letting a
liquidator skip the forfeit by omitting these accounts.

accounts.name: promo_vault_token
docs: The promo vault's cNGN, which forfeiture moves into the market vault (spec §11 step 3).
`promo_vault` is itself `Option`, so its `vault` field cannot be named in an `address`
constraint here — checked as a `constraint` instead, to the same effect.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays the position's rent (e.g. the gas-relay sponsor) and is refunded on close.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays the receipt's rent (e.g. the gas-relay sponsor) and is refunded when it is closed.

accounts.name: voucher_receipt
docs: Its creation is what stops a voucher being redeemed twice while this receipt lives: the
second attempt cannot initialize an account that already exists. The PDA seeds
`[VOUCHER_SEED, campaign, nonce]` do NOT include `voucher_expiry`, so the on-chain
guarantee is "one redemption per (campaign, nonce) per expiry epoch", not per
(campaign, nonce) outright — once the receipt is closed past expiry, only backend nonce
discipline (never reissuing the same nonce with a later expiry) prevents a replay.

accounts.name: market

accounts.name: promo_vault
docs: Forfeiture moves the position's promo backing into the market vault (spec §11 step 3),
so a written-off loan still returns what the protocol lent the borrower for free.
`create_promo_vault` is a separate admin action (`vault.rs`), so a market can run with
no promo vault at all. Required only when the position holds promo (`promo_balance >
0`) — the handler reverts with `PromoAccountsRequired` rather than silently skipping
the forfeit by omitting these accounts.

accounts.name: promo_vault_token
docs: `promo_vault` is itself `Option`, so its `vault` field cannot be named in an `address`
constraint here — checked as a `constraint` instead, to the same effect.

types.name: Campaign
docs: Spec §12. A budget the promo signer may issue vouchers against, until `redeem_until`.

fields.name: returned
docs: The unspent budget handed back to the vault's free cNGN.

fields.name: price_account
docs: Pyth price account this asset is pinned to. `Pubkey::default()` accepts any verified
update for `pyth_feed_id` inside `max_price_age_seconds`, so the caller may pick the
most favourable update in that window; pinning removes that choice.
Taken from the reserved padding, so the account size is unchanged.

fields.name: deposit_cap
docs: Raw token amounts.

fields.name: paused
docs: Blocks new deposits of this asset only.

fields.name: borrow_paused
docs: Blocks new *borrowing* backed by this asset. While set, the holding's
`lends_borrowing_power` is false, which suppresses both ways it could raise
`borrow_limit`: its own LTV term and the promo cap its value would otherwise unlock.
It still counts in full at `own_value` and at the liquidation line — including the
promo lift, which takes its own ungated cap — so pausing an asset can neither make a
live loan liquidatable nor make a position that was liquidatable a moment ago suddenly
safe. Deposits and seizure are unaffected.
**Withdrawal is not.** `withdraw_collateral` gates on the same `is_healthy()` the
borrow does, so while a loan is live a borrow-paused asset backs no withdrawal at all;
`a_borrow_paused_asset_backs_no_withdrawal_while_a_loan_is_live` pins that. Withdrawing
is exposure-increasing in the same way borrowing is, so this is intended — but it means
a pause does strand collateral behind a live loan until the loan is repaid or the pause
lifted.
Taken from the reserved padding, so the account size is unchanged.

fields.name: max_multiplier
docs: Per-asset ceiling on the mint's scaled-UI multiplier, in `MULTIPLIER_SCALE` fixed
point. `0` means no per-asset ceiling — only the global `MAX_MULTIPLIER` applies.
Exceeding it does not fail the price read: the asset simply stops lending borrowing
power, exactly as `borrow_paused` does. See the walk in `valuation.rs`.
Taken from the reserved padding, so the account size is unchanged.

fields.name: price_source
docs: Which oracle `valuation.rs` reads for this asset. See `PriceSource`.
Taken from the reserved padding, so the account size is unchanged.

fields.name: sb_feed_hash
docs: `SwitchboardOnDemand` only: the job definition this asset's feed must be running,
checked against `PullFeedAccountData.feed_hash` on every price read.
The pinned `price_account` alone is not enough. A pull feed's `authority` may rewrite
the account's `feed_hash`, repointing a pinned address from "PreStocks OPENAI mark
price" at any other job — and the account would still be the right address, owned by
the right program, carrying the right discriminator. This field is what makes that
repoint fail instead of silently repricing the collateral.
Taken from the reserved padding, so the account size is unchanged.

fields.name: sb_max_stale_slots
docs: `SwitchboardOnDemand` only: freshness bound in slots, the counterpart of
`max_price_age_seconds`. Switchboard's `CurrentResult` carries a slot and no timestamp.
Taken from the reserved padding, so the account size is unchanged.

fields.name: sb_min_samples
docs: `SwitchboardOnDemand` only: minimum oracle submissions behind the aggregated result.
Taken from the reserved padding, so the account size is unchanged.

types.name: CollateralSlot
docs: One collateral holding. `amount == 0` means the slot is free.

fields.name: treasury
docs: Owner of the token accounts that receive harvested reserve, swept donations
and withdrawn promo funds.

types.name: LoanSlot
docs: One fixed-term loan. `active == 0` means the slot is free.

fields.name: loss
docs: Principal plus the lender interest released for it, net of any promo forfeited in the
same call (`forfeited`). The gross figure is `loss + forfeited`.

fields.name: forfeited
docs: Promo forfeited to lenders in this same write-off, already netted out of `loss` and
`total_bad_debt`. Zero when the position held no promo, or when it was already forfeited
by an earlier liquidation.

fields.name: cash
docs: cNGN the program has recorded as held. Direct transfers to the vault are ignored.

fields.name: total_borrows
docs: Outstanding loan principal.

fields.name: lp_rate_product
docs: Σ over active loans of principal × rate_bps × (BPS − reserve_factor_bps).

fields.name: accrued_interest
docs: Lender interest accrued but not yet paid, already net of reserve.

fields.name: accrual_remainder
docs: Division remainder carried between accruals (numerator units of `lp_rate_product × seconds`).
Taken from the reserved padding, so the account size is unchanged.

fields.name: promo_clock_resumed_at
docs: When the promo inactivity clock last restarted, because the market was unpaused.
The clock is meant to measure a *borrower's* inactivity, and a paused market is one
the borrower cannot act on, so time spent paused must not count towards expiry.
Expiry therefore runs from `max(promo_last_activity_at, promo_clock_resumed_at)`.
Taken from the reserved padding, so the account size is unchanged.

types.name: MarketParams
docs: Admin-settable market parameters, used by `create_market` and `update_market_params`.

types.name: Position
docs: A borrower's collateral and loans. Zero-copy with fixed offsets so bots can scan it.
No `Option` fields: `market == Pubkey::default()` means no loan has been taken yet.

fields.name: bump
docs: Canonical, written once by `open_position` (`init`, so `ctx.bumps.position` is always
`find_program_address`'s result) and never touched again. The seven other position-PDA
sites — `take_loan`, `close_position`, `deposit_collateral`, `withdraw_collateral`,
`redeem_promo`, `expire_promo`, `revoke_promo` — read it back via
`bump = position.load()?.bump` instead of re-deriving it, which depends on this field
never holding anything but the canonical bump for as long as `open_position` stays the
only writer.

fields.name: market
docs: The market this position's loans come from.

types.name: PriceSource
docs: Which oracle prices a collateral asset.
`Pyth` is declared first so it is discriminant `0`. Every asset listed before this field
existed carries zeroed reserved padding where `price_source` now sits, so those assets
deserialize as `Pyth` and keep the behaviour they were listed with. Reordering these
variants silently repoints every live asset at a different oracle.

fields.name: amount
docs: Promo removed from the position. Always the position's whole balance.

fields.name: moved
docs: cNGN that actually reached the market vault. Equal to `amount` except after an issuer
clawback from the promo vault, where the transfer is clamped to the balance on hand —
see `forfeit_promo`. An indexer summing what lenders received must use this, not
`amount`.

types.name: PromoVault
docs: Spec §12. One per market: the cNGN behind every promo balance, and the accounting that keeps
`outstanding + unissued ≤ cash` true at all times.
- `cash` is what the program has recorded as held; a direct transfer to the token account is
ignored until it is swept, exactly as the market and collateral vaults treat donations.
- `outstanding` is the sum of every position's `promo_balance` — promo already handed out.
- `unissued` is the sum over active campaigns of `budget − granted` — promo promised to a
campaign but not yet redeemed.

types.name: VoucherReceipt
docs: Spec §12. Proof that one voucher nonce has been redeemed. Its existence is what prevents a
replay while it lives: `redeem_promo` creates it, so a second redemption of the same nonce
cannot init until it is closed. Its PDA seeds are `[VOUCHER_SEED, campaign, nonce]` — NOT
including `voucher_expiry`, which is only stored below — so the on-chain guarantee is "one
redemption per (campaign, nonce) per expiry epoch", not per (campaign, nonce) outright. Once
this receipt is closed past its expiry, the backend must never reissue the same nonce with a
later expiry, or the voucher becomes redeemable again.

fields.name: rent_payer
docs: Refunded when the receipt is closed, which anyone may do once the voucher has expired.

constants.name: VOUCHER_DOMAIN
docs: Domain separator in the voucher message (spec §12). It binds a signature to this program's
voucher format, so a `promo_signer` key reused elsewhere cannot produce a valid voucher.
Published in the IDL so the off-chain promo signer reads it rather than hardcoding a copy
that could drift from the program's.
